channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: At an amusement park in Florida, police officers confront a couple causing a disturbance. Inside a Wisconsin convenience store, a dissatisfied customer takes her frustration out on merchandise. In Arizona, an employee argues with two siblings after their car breaks down in a parking lot. During the opening ceremonies at a rugby match in France, a daring parachuting stunt goes wrong. In The Bahamas, passengers are left with few options after bad weather strands them at the airport.
